sourceCopy.name: Forex Position Size Calculator
sourceCopy.title: Forex Position Size Calculator Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Calculate forex lot size from account balance, risk, stop-loss pips and pip value. Free, private, no live FX data or account.
sourceCopy.intro: Estimate a position size from your chosen risk and stop distance. You supply the pip value in your account currency; this tool does not fetch exchange rates or broker data.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How do I calculate forex position size?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: Risk amount equals account balance times risk percent. Divide it by stop-loss pips times the pip value per standard lot. For example, risking 100 with 10 pips of stop distance and pip value 1 per lot gives 10 standard lots. Confirm pip value and contract size with your broker.
sourceCopy.privacyQuestion: Does this calculator connect to a broker?
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. It uses the figures you enter in this browser and does not connect to a broker, retrieve prices or place trades.

additionalFaqs.question: What is a pip value?
additionalFaqs.answer: Pip value is the money gained or lost for a one-pip move at a specified position size. It depends on the currency pair, trade size and account currency. Enter the value for one standard lot using your broker’s convention.

additionalFaqs.question: Does this calculate a live currency conversion?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. Enter pip value already converted to the same currency as your account balance. Exchange rates and broker contract conventions can change.

additionalFaqs.question: Is the position size a trading recommendation?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. It is arithmetic based on your inputs, not a forecast or recommendation. Leverage, spread, slippage, commissions, gaps and broker minimum sizes can change actual losses.

fields.pipValuePerStandardLot: Pip value per standard lot in account currency
fields.inputNote: Use the same currency for balance and pip value. A standard lot is modeled as 100,000 units; broker definitions can differ.
fields.accuracyNote: Illustrative position-size math only. Does not include spread, commission, slippage, gaps, margin, leverage or broker minimums. Not trading advice; you can lose more than planned.
fields.lossPerLot: Modeled loss per standard lot at stop

messages.checkInputs: Check balance, risk, stop distance and pip value.
